name: treatment-plan
title: DRAFT treatment plan
for_each: select id,code from dental.plans order by code

sections.title: Recorded plan
sections.note: A record of the treating practitioner's plan. Not a generated treatment recommendation or consent form.

sections.title: Items
sections.sql: select item_code,description,tooth,surface,fee_cents,completed_on from dental.plan_items where plan_id=$1 order by created_at,id

name: statement
title: DRAFT account statement
for_each: select id,name from dental.patients order by name

sections.title: Invoices and recorded receipts
sections.sql: select b.code,b.issued_on,b.due_on,b.currency,b.total_cents,b.received_cents,b.balance_cents from dental.balances b join dental.invoices i on i.id=b.id where i.patient_id=$1 order by b.issued_on
sections.note: Accounting record only. No payment or health fund claim is processed.

name: patient-record
title: DRAFT patient record extract
for_each: select id,name from dental.patients order by name

sections.title: Patient
sections.sql: select external_id,name,dob,medical_reviewed_on from dental.patients where id=$1

sections.title: Notes and corrections
sections.sql: select recorded_on,author,body,corrects_id,correction_reason from dental.notes where patient_id=$1 order by created_at,id
sections.note: Includes prior notes and every correction. No entries are replaced.

sections.title: Appointments
sections.sql: select day,starts,status,reason from dental.appointments where patient_id=$1 order by day,starts

name: recall-letter
title: DRAFT recall letter
for_each: select r.id,p.name from dental.recalls r join dental.patients p on p.id=r.patient_id where r.status='due' order by r.due_on

sections.title: Recall details
sections.sql: select patient,due_on,reason from dental.recall_queue where id=$1
sections.note: Please contact the practice to discuss a suitable appointment. Staff must check the record and contact preference before sharing. Nothing is sent.
